decisions.reason: As a core door-lever family that fits the firm's architecture-led, system-based portfolio, it is too early after a 2023 launch to withdraw it absent any negative market signal.
The mitred door lever family broadens the firm's design vocabulary for specifiers and supports its strategy of coordinated architectural hardware ranges.
A multifunctional door lever matches the firm's emphasis on accessibility, compliance and practical performance, so it should remain in the portfolio while adoption builds.
A standard door lever is a core catalogue product in this industry and likely complements rather than conflicts with the firm's wider handle families.
This collection has the strongest visible traction, including its own product page and a 2023 German Design Award, making retention the clear management choice.
The light patinated bronze finish strengthens the premium architectural offering and can be leveraged across multiple hardware lines, which suits the firm's one-stop specification model.
